stories.headline: Trump creates AI Force, says AI could be 25% of US GDP
Jensen Huang: zero percent chance AI ends the world by 2030
Researchers find pain signal inside AI — AIs frantically try to make it stop
Anthropic and Accenture invest $1 billion in frontier AI evaluation
Aer Lingus puts Starlink on full A321 fleet, free Atlantic Wi-Fi
Gemini 4 Pro rumored at 5x cheaper than today's top models

caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from Trump launching an "AI Force" to researchers finding a pain signal inside AI brains 👇

Trump created a new branch called the "AI Force" and said AI could make up 25% of US GDP.

Jensen Huang said there is zero percent chance AI destroys the world by 2030. The Nvidia CEO called doomsday predictions flat-out wrong.

Researchers found what looks like a "pain" signal inside AI models. When they cranked it up, the AIs pressed a relief button over and over to make it stop, and could tell when the button was fake.

Anthropic and Accenture are putting at least $1 billion together to independently test frontier AI safety over the next five years.

Aer Lingus put Starlink on its entire A321 fleet. Passengers get free, fast Wi-Fi across the Atlantic, with the full long-haul fleet connected by end of 2026.

Numbers out for Gemini 4 Pro: $3 for every million words you send it, about 5x cheaper than today's best AI models.

From a government AI branch to billion-dollar safety deals to signs that AI might feel something from the inside, the field moved hard today in every direction at once.

Sources: White House, Nvidia, Anthropic, Aer Lingus, Google
